title: Picking columns
setup:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv("games.csv")
explanation: Usually you only need a few columns. To pick one, put its name in square brackets and quotes: df["title"]. One column on its own is called a Series. To pick several, put a list of names inside: df[["title", "price"]]. Notice the double brackets: the outer ones mean 'pick', the inner ones make the list. Several columns give you a smaller DataFrame. Column names must match exactly, capital letters included.

lines.explain: Pick the title and genre columns, then show the first 5 rows. You can chain .head() right onto your selection.

solution_lines.explain: Outer brackets pick, inner brackets make the list of column names.
